mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that may lead the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and FEDFUNDS does not increase within the next 3 months, and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals a strong supply-side response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% in one month signals strong consumer demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 2% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in one month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% and 2% respectively in one month signals robust demand-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS > 2% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.
